data.exact_reserve_text: As at 31 December 2020, Syndicate 1110 is declaring a profit of GBP 5.9m (2019: loss of GBP 0.2m) of which GBP 7.9m is attributable to 2020 year of account, partially offset by losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant portion of gross claims reserves (GBP 59.3m at 31 Dec 2020) covered by NYMAGIC/Prosight reinsurance arrangements; whole account stop loss attachment point breached in September 2020, affecting recoveries and reserving considerations.
PSMAL commuted treaty business as at 31 March 2017 and entered quota-share and other reinsurance arrangements which affect the run-off of reserves and recoveries for 2017 & prior years.

named_events.loss_description: Underwrote a 90% ADC on casualty reserves for S1458 (2009-2017); increased syndicate gross written premium by GBP 95.2m and increased gross and net technical provisions by GBP 82.2m.
LPT strengthened the 2020 year of account reserve position by GBP 14.8m; gross written premium receivable GBP 17.3m and contributed a calendar year profit of GBP 1.5m as at 31 December 2020.

named_events.event_name: RITC of Syndicate 3330 2017 year of account
named_events.loss_description: Syndicate 3330 2017 YOA was accepted as an RITC as at 1 January 2020 with GBP 6.2m of net claims transferred to Syndicate 1110 2019 YOA.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 Syndicate 1110 reports opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 133.771m. The syndicate reports a net prior-year adverse movement (losses attributable to prior years) of GBP 2.0m, driven primarily by adverse claims development on run-off reinsurance business and influenced by reinsurance arrangements and changes in reserve presentation following novation. The reinsurance/capital transactions during the year (RITC, ADC and LPT) materially affected the composition of reserves, with casualty reinsurance being the dominant line impacted.
raw_causal_phrases: partially offset by losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively.
relate to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

At 31 December 2020 all Gross Claims Reserves, GBP 59.3m (2019: GBP 74.98m), were covered by the NYMAGIC/Prosight RI arrangements with the whole account stop loss (WASL) attachment point breached in September 2020.
Following novation, the decision was taken to remove loss funds from the paid claims and include the funds within IBNR.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from year-of-account result breakdown in the managing agent's report (losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m for prior years). The gross claims development triangle in the technical reserves note is present but not reliably machine-extractable in this text; additionally the triangle and reserve movements are distorted by RITC and LPT/ADC transactions accepted around year-end (RITC of 3330 2017, ADC on S1458, LPT from QBE), which can materially affect development patterns. Therefore PYD was taken from the YOA breakdown rather than triangle Movement-in-prior-years note. Users should treat the PYD attribution and LOB mapping as indicative.
